Deduplication suppresses rapid double-clicks (<300ms) on CTAs, chapter dwell requires >= 300ms stability while visible before emitting chapter_entered, and module-level document guards guarantee at most 1 started and 1 completed event per document lifecycle even across React StrictMode remounts and client locale transitions. Verified by network interception and storage tests in tests/e2e/analytics.spec.ts.

Robots and sitemap output valid static content without invented origins. Verified by 6 tests in tests/e2e/seo.spec.ts.
